messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol"
set: ["if you need surgery, tell the surgeon ahead of time that you are using carvedilol", "tell your eye surgeon ahead of time that you are using this medication", "tell surgeon ahead of time if needing surgery", "tell any doctor treating you that you are using buspirone", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using empagliflozin", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are using this medicine", "keep using carvedilol even if you feel well", "you should not stop using carvedilol suddenly", "tell any doctor who treats you that you are taking apixaban", "do not stop using carvedilol before surgery unless your surgeon tells you to", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant", "tell surgeon and anesthetist you take it", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "tell your doctor if you are of chinese descent", "tell your doctor if you are breast-feeding a baby", "tell your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
